sources.snippet: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next packed for sushi, a native inference engine for Apple Silicon. Target: a 48 GB Mac: 128k tokens of context at 8-bit KV. On 96 GB and 128 GB Macs it runs the full 1M-token context.

sources.snippet: Honest take: If you own a 24GB card, keep running Qwen3.8-27B and skip this entirely. If you own a 96-128GB unified-memory box, Flash-Next is the best local model you can run today — and its weird architecture (tiny KV cache, SSD-streamable embeddings) is a preview of what local inference looks like in 2027.
